verdict.rationale: Shopify documents an extensive, structured public API surface for AI agents via the Universal Commerce Protocol — MCP servers for catalog, cart, checkout, and order tracking, a CLI, JSON-RPC endpoints, profile-based auth/negotiation, and webhook subscriptions — all with detailed first-party reference docs and a runnable quickstart. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond Shopify's own docs, and a discoverable OpenAPI/schema spec (probe found 404s for openapi.json/llms.txt).
